vb_textbox.text: The knomes are paired up, so if the pink knome gives a good result the brown one will also give a good result, and vice versa. This means that when the purple knome gives a good result, the grey one will also give a good result, again vice versa. It seems random when these patterns switch but if the pink/brown knomes gave a bad result 3 times in a row, change to choosing the purple/grey knomes (and vice versa).
